carriers.name: HealthSpring
carriers.scope: 2027 source documents · 15 target states; NC True Choice pilot in comparisons
carriers.availability: 146 MA state/plan-segment entries collected across 12 target states with CMS/PDF county checks. LA, MI and NY have only standalone PDP entries in the reviewed HealthSpring catalog and CMS release. Comparison remains the one 11-county NC True Choice pilot.
carriers.benefits: 143 unique official EOC PDFs collected (162 state/document entries). Searchable library and MA segment CSV available. PA H3949-052 county summary omits Lehigh/Northampton; printed EOC and CMS agree and the discrepancy is noted. Full benefit comparisons beyond the NC pilot are pending.
carriers.medications: Six official 2027 shared formularies collected: 15,304 extracted candidates. Explicit applicability verifies 139 MA state/segments; seven MA-only entries have no included Part D. Assurance/Extra PDP lists remain separate. Only the NC pilot participates in medication comparison so far.
carriers.providers: NC PPO pilot: local suggestions from the official 2027 PDF (directory dated September 23, 2026), including exact offices and source pages. Partial provider/hospital extraction; missing entries remain unverified. HMO and other-state directories are not indexed. Live API network coverage is still unverified. EyeMed official locator linked for vision.
carriers.connection: Public plan lookup prepared with exact CMS segment and full-year validation. It checks for 2027 records when providers are entered and rejects historical mappings. Current public catalog has 618 records dated 2025/2026. Browser CORS tested; no authentication required for tested requests.
carriers.next_step: Extend verified benefit comparisons and directory indexing to additional plans/states; confirm 2027 API mappings before enabling live provider coverage claims.
